products.d: A premium solution for businesses wanting protection, professionalism and branding in one. Perfect for shipping, retail display or promotional kits, available in a wide range of sizes and made from strong corrugated cardboard so products arrive safely and stylishly.
products.long:
Product features

  • Multiple sizes – small items, medium parcels or bulkier products
  • Material options – E-flute or B-flute corrugated board, white or kraft
  • Print options – single-sided (outside) or double-sided (inside + outside) full-colour CMYK
  • Artwork templates provided – downloadable dielines with 1.5mm or 3mm bleed
  • Flat-packed – ships flat for easy storage and quick assembly
  • Eco-friendly – recyclable and sustainably sourced

Design flexibility

Bring print-ready artwork or use our design team. From bold logos on the outside to surprise messaging inside, every unboxing becomes a brand experience.

products.d: A clean, versatile packaging solution for businesses, creatives and individuals who want a sleek, minimalist box without compromising durability. Ideal for e-commerce shipping, subscription services, promotional kits and retail packaging. Arrives flat-packed and is easy to assemble.

Deliver more than a product, deliver a brand experience. Strength, structure and standout visual appeal so your packages arrive safely and leave a lasting impression. Perfect for e-commerce, wholesale, retail distribution and corporate logistics.
products.long:
Key features

  • Multiple sizes – small, medium and bulk shipments
  • Heavy-duty corrugated board – crush-resistant for tough shipping conditions
  • Custom printing – single-sided or double-sided full-colour CMYK
  • Print-ready templates – PDF dielines with bleed specs
  • Flat-packed – easy storage and fast assembly
  • Eco-friendly – recyclable, responsibly sourced

products.d: Simple, strong and reliable. High-quality unbranded cartons in sturdy corrugated cardboard, ideal for shipping, storage, moving or bulk dispatch. A range of sizes, no branding, perfect for clean and discreet shipping.
Flexible, interchangeable messaging. Lightweight and cost-effective. Includes 5mm corflute panels printed direct to substrate, so messaging is easy to swap out. Sturdy black frame with side lock.

products.d: Strong, weatherproof, long-lasting signage. Aluminium Composite Material panels give a sleek, rigid and highly durable signage solution, ideal for shopfronts, building fascia, directional signage, directories and outdoor branding.
Strong, weatherproof, long-lasting signage. Need a size that isn't standard? Order ACM at your own dimensions. Enter your width and height and we'll cut to size.

Lightweight, affordable, weather-resistant. The go-to solution for short to medium-term signage. Durable, versatile and cost-effective, perfect for events, construction sites, real estate and promotional campaigns.
Lightweight, affordable, weather-resistant. Corflute cut to your exact dimensions, any size up to 1200 × 2400 mm, with contour cutting to custom shapes available.
products.long:
Printed direct to 3mm or 5mm corflute with high-resolution latex inks, vibrant colour, fully waterproof and outdoor-durable. Single or double sided, with optional eyelets in the corners or centre-top for hanging and mounting.

Good to know

  • 3mm suits indoor or short-term outdoor use; 5mm is more rigid for windy or longer-term outdoor jobs
  • Any size up to 1200 × 2400 mm; contour cutting to custom shapes on request
  • Typical turnaround 2–4 business days from artwork approval, rush available

products.d: Durable anti-slip graphics for indoor and outdoor floors. Custom-sized floor graphics for wayfinding, promotions and safety zones.
